# Saint weapons

Weapons (kind 31) only the Saint can equip: flying blades, dual guns and wands.

Class page: [[wiki/classes/1-saint\|Saint]]. The weapon decides the skills: Q/W/E/R are the weapon's four normal skills (`WeaponBase`).

29 items.
